mapper.select: SELECT /* selectMasterCmClSalesReceiverUploadList */ X.DOC_NAME, X.TARGET, X.KEY_1, X.KEY_2, X.KEY_3, X.KEY_4, X.KEY_5, X.KEY_6, X.KEY_7, X.KEY_8, X.BILL_SEND_ERR_CHK, X.CONFIRM_ERR_CHK, X.USER_ERR_CHK, CASE WHEN X.USER_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '매출세금계산서 발행자 미일치' WHEN X.BILL_SEND_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '매출세금계산서 발행' WHEN X.CONFIRM_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '매출세금계산서 확정' ELSE '정상' END AS STATUS FROM ( SELECT A.DOC_NAME, A.TARGET, A.KEY_1, A.KEY_2, A.KEY_3, A.KEY_4, A.KEY_5, A.KEY_6, A.KEY_7, A.KEY_8, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN WHERE SEQ_ID = A.TARGET), 0, 'N', 'Y') AS BILL_SEND_ERR_CHK, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = A.TARGET AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y'), 0, 'N', 'Y') AS CONFIRM_ERR_CHK, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = A.TARGET AND ADD_USER_ID = A.KEY_5), 0, 'Y', 'N') AS USER_ERR_CHK FROM BNTTRXL A WHERE 1=1 AND A.DOC_NAME = 'AR_EMAIL' AND KEY_5 = #{st_user_id} ) X ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(KEY_8)
mapper.update: /*setBnttrxlUploadReg1*/ INSERT INTO BNTTRXL ( DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10, KEY_11, KEY_12, KEY_13, KEY_14, KEY_15 ) VALUES( #{DOC_NAME}, #{TARGET}, NVL(( SELECT NVL(NVL(AR.GR_CREATOR_NAME,MAIN.BYR_EMP_NAME),BILL.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM KEPTARDT AR, XXSB_DTI_MAIN MAIN, BILL_ACCOUNTING BILL WHERE AR.SITE IN ('KA', 'KK') AND AR.STATUS != 'D' AND NVL(AR.AR_TYPE,'01') = '01' AND AR.ADD_USER_ID = #{ST_USER_ID} AND AR.TAX_BILL_NO = #{TARGET} AND AR.TAX_BILL_NO = MAIN.SEQ_ID (+) AND AR.BUYER_CODE = BILL.COM_CODE (+) AND BILL.PRIORITY (+)= 'Y' AND MAIN.STATUS (+)!= 'D' AND AR.IRS_NO = BILL.IRS_NO (+) ),' '), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_2}), '', ' ', #{KEY_2}), NVL(( SELECT NVL(NVL(AR.GR_CREATOR_EMAIL,MAIN.BYR_EMAIL),BILL.EMAIL) FROM KEPTARDT AR, XXSB_DTI_MAIN MAIN, BILL_ACCOUNTING BILL WHERE AR.SITE IN ('KA', 'KK') AND AR.STATUS != 'D' AND NVL(AR.AR_TYPE,'01') = '01' AND AR.ADD_USER_ID = #{ST_USER_ID} AND AR.TAX_BILL_NO = #{TARGET} AND AR.TAX_BILL_NO = MAIN.SEQ_ID (+) AND AR.BUYER_CODE = BILL.COM_CODE (+) AND BILL.PRIORITY (+)= 'Y' AND MAIN.STATUS (+)!= 'D' AND AR.IRS_NO = BILL.IRS_NO (+) ),' '), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_4}), '', ' ', #{KEY_4}), #{ST_USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), (SELECT TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(KEY_8), 0))+1 FROM BNTTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = #{DOC_NAME} AND KEY_5 = #{ST_USER_ID}), ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ' )
